dedupe_keys.name: eia petroleum and other liquids data including the petroleum supply monthly supply stocks movements prices by pad district

description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes US petroleum statistics on its petroleum data index, read on 2026-09-26. Weekly supply estimates (released 23 September 2026) give production, refinery inputs and utilisation, stocks, days of supply, imports, exports and product supplied for the US and each Petroleum Administration for Defense (PAD) district. Prices cover weekly retail gasoline and diesel, spot and NYMEX futures prices and seasonal heating oil and propane. The Petroleum Supply Monthly, with June 2026 data released on 1 September 2026 and the next release on 30 September 2026, gives supply and disposition of crude oil and products nationally and by PAD district: production, refinery and blender operations, imports by country of origin, exports by destination, stocks, and movements between districts by pipeline, tanker, barge and rail. PDF and CSV files of the monthly have been discontinued; tables are on the web and downloadable as XLS, free of charge, and as US government works are in the public domain with acknowledgement asked. Caveats: monthly figures are preliminary until the Petroleum Supply Annual. Simulation uses are calibrating fuel supply network flow models between regions, stock-based resilience of fuel supply and capacity planning. Related records: data-eia-refinery-capacity-report and data-jodi-oil-world-database.
